description: Defines the TestRootCerts class and related helpers for managing trusted root certificates in unit tests, including platform-specific handling for Windows and iOS.

classes.name: TestRootCerts
classes.description: Helper class for managing trusted root certificates in tests, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: ScopedTestRoot
classes.description: RAII helper class to temporarily add trusted root certificates for testing.

classes.name: ScopedTestKnownRoot
classes.description: Helper class to mark certificates as known roots without trusting them.

methods.name: HasInstance
methods.description: Checks if an instance of TestRootCerts exists.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if no certificates are trusted.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a DER-encoded certificate is a known root.

methods.name: FixupSecTrustRef
methods.description: Modifies a SecTrustRef to include test roots (iOS).

methods.name: GetChainEngine
methods.description: Returns a chain engine suitable for validation (Windows).

methods.name: AddKnownRoot
methods.description: Marks a DER-encoded cert as a known root.

methods.name: AddImpl
methods.description: Internal method to add a certificate.

methods.name: ClearImpl
methods.description: Internal method to clear trust store.

methods.name: ScopedTestRoot
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for managing temporary trusted roots.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Replaces current trusted roots with new set.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ScopedTestRoot has no certificates.

methods.name: ScopedTestKnownRoot
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for marking known roots.
